hotspots.title: Mass protests demand Sánchez resignation
hotspots.blurb: Tens of thousands marched in Madrid demanding Spanish PM Pedro Sánchez's resignation over corruption scandals, with Vox and PP leaders joining the protests. The demonstrations followed Zapatero's indictment in the Plus Ultra case.
hotspots.affect: This commands disproportionate attention due to its high moral charge and polarized contention, with right-wing and far-right groups framing it as a fight against systemic corruption.

hotspots.title: AfD’s poll surge and leadership ambitions
hotspots.blurb: Germany's AfD party continues to gain traction in polls, with debates over cooperation with other parties intensifying. Former SPD leaders suggest breaking the 'firewall' against AfD, sparking internal party conflicts.
hotspots.affect: This hotspot is charged due to alarmist framing around AfD's rise and the potential for far-right governance, alongside cross-party debates on democratic norms.

hotspots.title: Trump administration restricts green card applications
hotspots.blurb: The Trump administration announced a policy change requiring most green card applicants to leave the U.S. for processing, reversing a decades-old practice. This has sparked backlash from immigration advocates and businesses.
hotspots.affect: This commands attention due to its strong moral charge around immigration policy and the potential humanitarian and economic impacts, framed as a triumph by MAGA supporters.

hotspots.title: La Libertad Avanza internal power struggles
hotspots.blurb: Argentina's ruling La Libertad Avanza party faces escalating internal conflicts, with factions led by Karina Milei and Santiago Caputo clashing over political strategies. The disputes threaten the government's stability.
hotspots.affect: This hotspot is charged due to its leadership crisis tone and polarized contention within the ruling party, with high stakes for Argentina's political future.

hotspots.title: Meloni’s government faces backlash over policies
hotspots.blurb: Italy's Prime Minister Giorgia Meloni faces criticism over her government's handling of energy crises, migration, and economic policies. Opposition leaders and allies like Matteo Salvini clash over fiscal and social issues.
hotspots.affect: This commands attention due to its polarized contention and alarmist framing around Italy's economic and social stability, with high affective investment from both supporters and critics.
